'''December 1999 Rochester tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rochester, NY on 11 December 1999. It is known from R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d145">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-14-rochester-ny-12-11-1999d145/ rochester-ny-12-11-1999], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 14 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-14-rochester-ny-12-11-1999d145/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 December 1999
* '''Site:''' Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 15
